capabilities: Plan manuscripts with parts, chapters, and scenes in an outline
Keep reference notes for characters, locations, plotlines, and timelines
Save and restore text versions of sections
Check manuscripts for missing files, incomplete sections, and broken links
Export the assembled manuscript to EPUB, DOCX, Markdown, or HTML
extras: Closed-source binary that is free to install and use. Interface localized in Russian, English, and Simplified Chinese; the sample manuscript is in Russian. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for planning a novel scene by scene, tracking manuscript versions, or assembling and exporting a finished book.

relations.evidence: The configured local Ollama server receives the selected passage and the instructions for that task.

summary: Fiction writing workspace that plans manuscripts scene by scene, keeps character and location notes, saves text versions, and exports to EPUB, DOCX, Markdown, or HTML.
